notes.title: Space Farm now only $11.99
notes.content:
The launch of Space Farm and 4 years of trials and tribulations came to a halt after launch. It was thousands of hours of work, re-doing mistakes, learning, and finishing.

But, we are very happy to say we launched our first game. However, that is only where the work starts with this game.

We have decided a lot of the issues so far stem from the original programming, which we did not do. And was done very incorrectly. So we are starting from scratch, to allow for future mods, updates, features, and more in-depth gameplay!

This might take some time, however, we are dedicated to this game, and think we can really bring something special to the gaming world one day!

We thank everyone for supporting us and continuing to follow our journey.

notes.title: Small helpers
notes.content:
Added back the small helpers, they dont break the game now, which is great!

We have created a list of 30 things that we think are the most important bugs, features, and fixes. And are planning on slowly releasing these updates over the coming few weeks. Including a brand new starting scene to help transition the player into our game better!

Thanks for all the support!!

notes.title: Quest helpers, not so helpful
notes.content:
We added new helper icons, but it's breaking something. So we just pushed an update to remove them.

Also, we fixed a bug where you couldn't use water when energy was at 0.

notes.title: INFO Buttons
notes.content:
So in todays update, we took one of our Forum users suggestions and made the font larger and more spaced during questing.

As well, we added info icons in the game, to give you a bit more of a heads up as to what certain things do.

A few other updates to help with general flow.

notes.title: Water refill HUGE UPDATE
notes.content:
No its not huge. haha. But we did make it so its SUPER easy to refill the water anywhere near any body of water in the game.

We also made it so that the volume slider works on the homepage (again..)

And we added various screensizes to window mode.

notes.title: Map unlock balancing.
notes.content: We have made it easier to access some areas of the map to ensure it is reasonably easy to unlock the important areas for questing first.

notes.title: Minor tweaks
notes.content:
We noticed there was a minor bug that didn't allow the esc button to work which caused lots of problems. This has been fixed now, and we're awaiting a bit more feedback before releasing our next update to help the player start their journey in the game more smoothly. 

Updates will be done weekly for Space Farm for the year!!

notes.title: October 1st Launch Date
notes.content:
This is a short announcement to let everyone know, that nearly 4 years into development. And a lot of bumps along the way, Space Farm will be launching on October 1st!

While there is a possibility we delay again, unless something major happens, we should be good!

I hope you follow us and help us build off this base game we are bringing to you.

notes.title: Mac OS Build added
notes.content: We are testing out this cool feature upload. As well, announcing that we have managed to update our first release to work on Windows and MacOS operating systems. How exciting!

notes.title: Space Farm, Release Update
notes.content:
We have finally got the game in a near stable position on PC and Mac. We are now down to final polishing and bug testing. Adding final effects and Audio. Ensuring the questing experience is smooth. Unlocks, farming, marketplace, all the things!

Keep an eye out for our official release date announcement coming very soon!
